proposed_comments.title: Clear active state before hiding the shortcut dialog
proposed_comments.body:
### Clear active state before hiding the shortcut dialog

**Severity:** `medium`

Hiding the dialog can synchronously raise its closing path. The active-state flag must be cleared before that call so a lifecycle transition cannot observe the control as active while its editor is already being torn down. Clear the flag first, then hide the dialog.

```suggestion
               _isActive = false;
               shortcutDialog?.Hide();
```

confidence.rationale: The current teardown hides the dialog before clearing active state; the exact candidate reverses those operations.

proposed_comments.title: Capture the shared repository configuration field
proposed_comments.body:
### Capture the shared repository configuration field

**Severity:** `medium`

The fixture needs to isolate only the configuration held by the repository shared with `HotkeyConflictIgnoreHelper`; replacing the process-wide static repository makes the helper retain a different instance. Add a handle for that existing instance configuration so it can be replaced and restored without changing the shared repository identity.

```suggestion
           private static readonly FieldInfo RepositoryField = typeof(SettingsRepository<GeneralSettings>).GetField("settingsRepository", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
           private static readonly FieldInfo SettingsConfigField = typeof(SettingsRepository<GeneralSettings>).GetField("settingsConfig", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
```

confidence.rationale: The validated candidate adds a configuration field handle while preserving the helper shared repository identity.

proposed_comments.title: Reuse the helper shared repository during fixture setup
proposed_comments.body:
### Reuse the helper shared repository during fixture setup

**Severity:** `medium`

HotkeyConflictIgnoreHelper captures the shared settings repository during type initialization. Creating and publishing a replacement static repository after that point splits the test fixture from the helper, producing order-dependent behavior and leaking global test state. Initialize the helper first, retain its repository, and temporarily replace only its settings configuration.

```suggestion
           private static SettingsRepository<GeneralSettings> repository;
           private static GeneralSettings previousSettingsConfig;
```

confidence.rationale: The candidate reuses the helper repository and swaps only its configuration, removing the process-wide repository replacement.

proposed_comments.title: Capture the dispatcher before constructing the test application
proposed_comments.body:
### Capture the dispatcher before constructing the test application

**Severity:** `medium`

The fixture signals readiness from the test application constructor. Capture the thread dispatcher before constructing that application so initialization cannot complete while dispatcher is still unset. This keeps cleanup deterministic if the test app immediately signals its ready task.

```suggestion
                               dispatcher = DispatcherQueue.GetForCurrentThread();
                               _ = new ShortcutTestApplication(ready);
```

confidence.rationale: The exact candidate captures DispatcherQueue before the constructor can signal readiness.

proposed_comments.title: Restore shared settings configuration in finally

confidence.rationale: The candidate moves restoration into finally so failed shutdown assertions cannot leak process-wide test configuration.
